scenes.text: Watch and read: While at the market, Ama thinks about this: What should come first in writing about “My School”?
The answer is: List ideas to include. Plan before drafting.
Watch and read: Kojo is learning with a partner at school. Which plan best organises a paragraph about a market?
The answer is: Where it is, what people sell, why it matters. Group related ideas in a useful order.
